pages.text: The first island of the Void.

Amun's dimension, reached only through the artifact's portal: eternal night, a black sky with red flashes, islands in the dark joined by paths of void bricks, little to take (a few mineral crystals and chests), no monsters of the overworld. One arrives on the first island beside the portal back. Falling off the islands is death.$(br2)Four large $(l)islands of riches$() hold a lake inside and a field of six crystals: vespene lakes, one of $(l)terrazine$() (violet, worth twice vespene) and one with $(l)gold minerals$() (each trip worth twice). A lake's two outlets take gas buildings and fill again from the lake.$(br2)Your army answers your command panel there as at home; buildings cannot be put down away from your base's world.
